name: H3_geometry

phase_0.boundary_condition: Sphere at infinity compactifying H3 space

VINIT.justification: Initial void before any points or structures exist

TANCH.justification: Closed boundary containing all H3 points and geodesics

AFWD.justification: Forward propagation along a geodesic from a point

AREV.justification: Reverse projection to tangent space from a displaced point

CLINK.justification: Chaining transformations to form new isometries

FSPLIT.justification: Splits tangent vectors into geodesic-aligned (T) and non-aligned (F) subsets

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes full tangent space from geodesic and non-geodesic subsets

ENGAGR.justification: Surface equidistant to boundary point, simultaneously finite and ideal

phase_2.split_input: Set of all tangent vectors at P

phase_3.void_description: H3 space without metric, points, or isometries
phase_3.true_description: Valid geodesic segment minimizing path length
phase_3.false_description: Path violating geodesic equation with non-minimal length
phase_3.both_description: Horosphere exhibiting both bounded curvature and ideal boundary properties

steps.domain_action: Place base point P via exponential map
Partition tangent space at P into geodesic-aligned (T) and non-aligned (F) vectors
Propagate from P along geodesic-aligned vector to point Q (T-arm)
Propagate from P along non-geodesic vector to point R (F-arm)
Confirm PR path fails length minimization (F-arm)
Project R back to tangent space at P via inverse exponential map (F-arm)
Reunite geodesic and non-geodesic vector subsets into full tangent space
Identify point fixed under composed isometry
Generate horosphere tangent to ideal boundary
Anchor entire system to sphere at infinity

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Axioms of hyperbolic geometry and curvature constraints
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Geodesic flow and parallel transport along paths
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Levi-Civita connection storing metric and parallel translation data
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Isometry group action determining point transformations
phase_5.alfs_store: Constant negative curvature invariant defining H3

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Initial point and tangent vector configuration
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Isometries preserve metric and path reversibility maintains energy conservation
